entities.summary: Mikael Jan Svanberg, better known as Lord Ahriman, is a Swedish musician who is the primary guitarist, songwriter and sole founding member of the black metal band Dark Funeral. He is also the rhythm guitarist in the band Wolfen Society. His stage name is derived from Ahriman, the evil equivalent of the deity Ahura Mazda in Zoroastrianism.
